-- A gift is an immutable ledger line. A refund or correction is a negative
-- reversal line; amounts, dates and references never change. Only the
-- goods-or-services fact of an imported gift may move once from unknown, and
-- erasure may clear the free-text note and move the line to the anonymous
-- placeholder that replaces an erased donor.
CREATE TABLE cf_gifts (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0),
 donor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cf_donors(id),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('gift','reversal')),
 reverses TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES cf_gifts(id),
 received_on TEXT NOT NULL,
 amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
 method TEXT NOT NULL,
 reference TEXT,
 fund TEXT NOT NULL,
 pledge_id TEXT REFERENCES cf_pledges(id),
 goods TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(goods IN ('none','provided','unknown')),
 goods_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(goods_cents >= 0),
 goods_description TEXT,
 note TEXT,
 source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('manual','stripe')),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 CHECK((kind = 'gift' AND amount_cents > 0 AND reverses IS NULL) OR (kind = 'reversal' AND amount_cents < 0 AND reverses IS NOT NULL)),
 CHECK(goods_cents <= abs(amount_cents)),
 CHECK(goods = 'provided' OR goods_cents = 0)
);
CREATE INDEX cf_gift_donor ON cf_gifts(donor_id, received_on);
CREATE INDEX cf_gift_received ON cf_gifts(received_on);

WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR (NEW.donor_id IS NOT OLD.donor_id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cf_donors WHERE id = NEW.donor_id AND erased_at IS NOT NULL)) OR NEW.kind IS NOT OLD.kind OR NEW.reverses IS NOT OLD.reverses
 OR NEW.received_on IS NOT OLD.received_on OR NEW.amount_cents IS NOT OLD.amount_cents OR NEW.method IS NOT OLD.method
 OR NEW.reference IS NOT OLD.reference OR NEW.fund IS NOT OLD.fund OR NEW.pledge_id IS NOT OLD.pledge_id
 OR NEW.source IS NOT OLD.source OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR NEW.created_by IS NOT OLD.created_by
 OR (NEW.note IS NOT OLD.note AND NEW.note IS NOT NULL)
 OR ((NEW.goods IS NOT OLD.goods OR NEW.goods_cents IS NOT OLD.goods_cents OR NEW.goods_description IS NOT OLD.goods_description) AND OLD.goods <> 'unknown')
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'COFFER_GIFT_IMMUTABLE'); END;

-- board member/foundation officer of B; A was introduced by B. Spouses are

 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE cf_interactions (

);
CREATE INDEX cf_interaction_donor ON cf_interactions(donor_id,occurred_on,recorded_at);

-- Native erasure marks the original donor before replacing it with an
-- anonymous ledger placeholder. Clear private content at that moment, even
-- when an erasure caller does not know about these newer tables.
CREATE TRIGGER cf_donor_depth_erasure AFTER UPDATE OF erased_at ON cf_donors
WHEN OLD.erased_at IS NULL AND NEW.erased_at IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
 DELETE FROM cf_relationships WHERE donor_id=NEW.id OR related_donor_id=NEW.id;
 DELETE FROM cf_interactions WHERE donor_id=NEW.id;
END;

CREATE TABLE cf_pledge_allocations (

 gift_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cf_gifts(id),
 amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents > 0),

 UNIQUE(installment_id,gift_id)

CREATE INDEX cf_pledge_allocation_gift ON cf_pledge_allocations(gift_id);
-- Reversal lines undo their original gift's allocations without editing history.
CREATE VIEW cf_pledge_balances AS
 SELECT i.*,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount_cents) FROM cf_pledge_allocations a
 JOIN cf_gifts g ON g.id=a.gift_id AND g.kind='gift'
 WHERE a.installment_id=i.id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cf_gifts r WHERE r.reverses=g.id)),0) AS paid_cents
 FROM cf_pledge_installments i;

-- Attribution is separate from the immutable cash ledger. A credit or expected
-- match never creates cash, a tax receipt, or a second financial total.
CREATE TABLE cf_soft_credits (

CREATE TABLE cf_gift_tributes (

 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE cf_employer_matches (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 gift_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cf_gifts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 employer_donor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cf_donors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents > 0),
 due_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 received_gift_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES cf_gifts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(gift_id, employer_donor_id),
 CHECK(received_gift_id IS NULL OR received_gift_id <> gift_id)
);
CREATE INDEX cf_employer_match_donor ON cf_employer_matches(employer_donor_id);
-- Native erasure moves ledger lines to an anonymous placeholder before deleting
-- the original donor. Clear personal attribution while its old links still exist.
CREATE TRIGGER cf_gift_depth_erasure AFTER UPDATE OF erased_at ON cf_donors
WHEN OLD.erased_at IS NULL AND NEW.erased_at IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
 -- A tribute can name this donor on somebody else's receipt. Redact those
 -- frozen artifacts too; their old approval hash deliberately stops delivery.
 UPDATE cf_acks SET subject='[erased]',body='[erased]',statement_gifts=NULL
 WHERE gift_id IN (SELECT gift_id FROM cf_gift_tributes WHERE donor_id=NEW.id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(cf_acks.statement_gifts) j JOIN cf_gift_tributes t ON t.gift_id=json_extract(j.value,'$.id') WHERE t.donor_id=NEW.id);
 DELETE FROM cf_soft_credits WHERE donor_id=NEW.id OR gift_id IN (SELECT id FROM cf_gifts WHERE donor_id=NEW.id);
 DELETE FROM cf_gift_tributes WHERE donor_id=NEW.id OR gift_id IN (SELECT id FROM cf_gifts WHERE donor_id=NEW.id);
 DELETE FROM cf_employer_matches WHERE employer_donor_id=NEW.id OR gift_id IN (SELECT id FROM cf_gifts WHERE donor_id=NEW.id);
END;

 OR NEW.source IS NOT OLD.source OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR NEW.created_by IS NOT OLD.created_by

BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'COFFER_GIFT_IMMUTABLE'); END;

WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.channel IS NOT OLD.channel OR NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status
 OR NEW.method IS NOT OLD.method OR NEW.evidence IS NOT OLD.evidence OR NEW.captured_on IS NOT OLD.captured_on
 OR NEW.recorded_at IS NOT OLD.recorded_at OR NEW.recorded_by IS NOT OLD.recorded_by

-- The payments subledger changes contribution balances without editing gifts.

CREATE VIEW cf_fund_ledger AS

 SELECT a.id AS allocation_id,a.gift_id,a.position,a.fund,a.campaign_id,a.amount_cents,
  COALESCE(SUM(a.amount_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY a.gift_id ORDER BY a.position ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) AS start_cents
 FROM cf_gift_allocations a
 UNION ALL
 SELECT NULL,g.id,1,g.fund,cg.campaign_id,g.amount_cents,0 FROM cf_gifts g
 LEFT JOIN cf_campaign_gifts cg ON cg.gift_id=g.id
 WHERE g.kind='gift' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cf_gift_allocations WHERE gift_id=g.id)

 SELECT p.id,p.gift_id,g.amount_cents+SUM(p.contribution_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY p.gift_id ORDER BY p.created_at,p.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS after_cents
 FROM cf_payment_entries p JOIN cf_gifts g ON g.id=p.gift_id WHERE p.contribution_cents<>0
),
entries AS (
 SELECT l.*,COALESCE(a.gift_id,l.reverses,l.id) AS gift_id,
  COALESCE(a.after_cents,l.amount_cents) AS after_cents,
  CASE WHEN a.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.after_cents-l.amount_cents END AS before_cents
 FROM cf_contribution_ledger l LEFT JOIN adjustments a ON a.id=l.id
),
boundaries AS (
 SELECT e.id,p.allocation_id,p.position,g.amount_cents AS denominator,
  CAST(CASE b.value WHEN 0 THEN p.start_cents ELSE p.start_cents+p.amount_cents END AS TEXT) AS digits,
  CASE t.value WHEN 0 THEN e.before_cents ELSE e.after_cents END AS cents,
  CASE WHEN b.value=t.value THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS direction
 FROM entries e JOIN parts p ON p.gift_id=e.gift_id JOIN cf_gifts g ON g.id=e.gift_id
 CROSS JOIN json_each('[0,1]') b CROSS JOIN json_each('[0,1]') t
 WHERE p.allocation_id IS NOT NULL AND e.source='stripe-adjustment'

-- Long division by decimal digits keeps every intermediate an integer. Direct
-- cents * allocation multiplication can overflow SQLite's 64-bit integers.

 SELECT id,allocation_id,position,denominator,digits,cents,direction,1,0,0 FROM boundaries
 UNION ALL
 SELECT id,allocation_id,position,denominator,digits,cents,direction,step+1,
  10*quotient+CAST(substr(digits,step,1) AS INTEGER)*(abs(cents)/denominator)
   +(10*remainder+CAST(substr(digits,step,1) AS INTEGER)*(abs(cents)%denominator))/denominator,
  (10*remainder+CAST(substr(digits,step,1) AS INTEGER)*(abs(cents)%denominator))%denominator
 FROM division WHERE step<=length(digits)
),
amounts AS (
 SELECT id,allocation_id,position,SUM(direction*CASE WHEN cents<0 THEN -quotient ELSE quotient END) AS amount_cents
 FROM division WHERE step>length(digits) GROUP BY id,allocation_id,position
)
SELECT e.id,e.gift_id,p.allocation_id,p.position,e.version,e.donor_id,e.kind,e.reverses,e.received_on,

 e.method,e.reference,CASE WHEN p.allocation_id IS NULL THEN e.fund ELSE p.fund END AS fund,
 p.campaign_id,e.pledge_id,e.source,e.created_at,e.created_by
FROM entries e JOIN parts p ON p.gift_id=e.gift_id LEFT JOIN amounts a ON a.id=e.id AND a.position=p.position;
